text:
slowness is beauty

I copy these borrowed lines

I breathe

I accept the light

under the thin air of November

under the grass

without color

under the cracked

gray sky

I accept mourning and feast

I have not arrived

I will never arrive

at the center of everything

is the intact poem,

inescapable sun,

night without turning its head.

I prowl its light,

its animal shadow

of words,

I sniff its splendor,

its footprint,

its remains,

all to say

that once

I was attentive,

disarmed,


alone almost

in death,

almost in fire.

translation.title: In a Low Voice
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the low-voiced ars poetica of circling the intact poem without arriving.
